Word.run.notes: Create a server or browser runtime, then use runtime.run(batch). The package does not export Word.run.

Word.SearchOptions#ignorePunct.notes: The option compiles, but true is refused with NotSupported.

Word.SearchOptions#ignoreSpace.notes: The option compiles, but true is refused with NotSupported.

Word.SearchOptions#matchWildcards.notes: The option compiles, but true is refused with NotSupported.

Word.Range#select.notes: Selection requires an attached browser editor. Check runtime.capabilities.selection; server runtimes refuse with NotSupported.

Word.ContentControl#id.notes: The file id is a string rather than a number. DOCX ids can be missing or repeated; do not use this value as unique identity.

Word.Font#bold.notes: Reads return null for mixed, unspecified, or inherited values. Writes require a boolean.

Word.Font#italic.notes: Reads return null for mixed, unspecified, or inherited values. Writes require a boolean.

Word.Font#color.notes: Reads return null for mixed, unspecified, or inherited values. Writes require a string.

Word.Font#name.notes: Reads return null for mixed, unspecified, or inherited values. Writes require a string.

Word.Font#size.notes: Reads return null for mixed, unspecified, or inherited values. Writes require a number.

Word.Range#insertComment.notes: Writes require an explicit author. Browser writes also require the Pro review module and an editable document.

Word.Section#getHeader.notes: Returns existing or inherited parts only. A missing header returns ItemNotFound; a read never creates a part.

Word.Section#getFooter.notes: Returns existing or inherited parts only. A missing footer returns ItemNotFound; a read never creates a part.
